column1: # Charon fleet roadmap — canonical source of truth for status/handoff/HTML reports.
# One row per item. Tab-separated. Fields: project<TAB>id<TAB>status<TAB>phase<TAB>name<TAB>goal<TAB>wave
# status: done in-review building queued designed parked not-started
# phase:  4th field, retained for back-compat; the renderer DERIVES the phase word from status.
# goal:   plain-language outcome / description (renderers show it as the ticket's description).
# wave:   7th field. "Wave A — <theme>" groups items inside a project. Every item now has a wave
#         (Projects -> Waves -> tickets). fleet/report.sh renders the terminal view;
#         fleet/roadmap-html.sh renders the full-page HTML/Artifact view from THIS file.
# ORDER CONVENTION (2026-07-10 agreed): within each WAVE, status-progression —
#   done -> building(now) -> queued -> designed -> parked -> not-started, ascending id within a status.
# PROJECT + WAVE order = order-of-first-appearance; rows render in input order. Edit here, re-render.
